svg.title: Yard enemy approach routes and barrel positions
svg.desc: 298 sampled navigation paths. Grey circles are old barrel positions; orange circles are adjusted positions. Lines show shifts of at most 2.5 metres.
svg.text: 298 navigation routes / 16 barrels / maximum shift 2.5 m
Blue: routes. Grey: original. Orange: adjusted. Navigation estimate, not player telemetry.
